mapper.select:
SELECT O.ORDER_ID, O.ORDER_TYPE, O.ORDER_STATUS, O.TOTAL_PRICE, O.DISCOUNT_AMT, O.CREATED_AT, O.USER_ID,
D.DELIVERY_ID, D.DELIVERY_STATUS, D.TRACKING_NO,
OI.ITEM_ID, OI.PRODUCT_ID, P.PRODUCT_NAME, B.BRAND_NAME AS BRAND_NAME, C.CATEGORY_NAME AS CATEGORY_NAME, OI.UNIT_PRICE AS ITEM_PRICE, OI.QUANTITY AS ITEM_COUNT, OI.START_DATE, OI.END_DATE,
(SELECT PI.IMG_URL FROM PRODUCT_IMG PI WHERE PI.PRODUCT_ID = OI.PRODUCT_ID ORDER BY PI.IS_MAIN DESC LIMIT 1) AS IMG_URL
FROM ORDERS O LEFT JOIN DELIVERY D ON O.ORDER_ID = D.ORDER_ID LEFT JOIN ORDER_ITEM OI ON O.ORDER_ID = OI.ORDER_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT P ON OI.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID LEFT JOIN BRAND B ON P.BRAND_ID = B.BRAND_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_CATEGORY C ON P.CATEGORY_ID = C.CATEGORY_ID WHERE O.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY O.CREATED_AT DESC, OI.ITEM_ID ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE ORDERS SET ORDER_STATUS = 'CANCELLED' WHERE ORDER_ID = #{orderId} AND ORDER_STATUS IN ('PAID', 'READY', 'PAY_COMPLETED')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ORDER_CANCEL ( CANCEL_REASON_CODE, CANCEL_REASON_TEXT, CANCEL_AMOUNT, CANCEL_STATUS, REQUESTED_AT, ORDER_ID ) VALUES ( #{cancelReasonCode}, #{cancelReasonText}, #{cancelAmount}, 'COMPLETED', NOW(), #{orderId} )
